description: Device, Agent, and Multi-Client Association Contract

relationship_topology.device_record: 1 singleton per physical/emulated device in DeviceRegistry
relationship_topology.client_connections: 0 to N active WebSocket connections per device (/connect_client)
relationship_topology.client_id_allocation: Monotonically increasing integer per device session (1, 2, ...)

message_routing_flow.client_to_agent: Client sends forward -> Server stamps client_id -> Relays to Agent
message_routing_flow.agent_to_client: Agent sends forward with target client_id -> Server unpackages -> Relays to Client as device_msg
